title: 1_Introduction_to_Java_Language_Lecture_1_
text: To run Java code, our code goes through two steps.

title: 1_Introduction_to_Java_Language_Lecture_1_
text: The first step is compilation and the second step is execution.

title: 1_Introduction_to_Java_Language_Lecture_1_
text: Now the Java development kit that we have downloaded, that is JDK, has a component called JRE.

title: 1_Introduction_to_Java_Language_Lecture_1_

text: And this JRE also has another component inside it, which we call JVM.

title: 1_Introduction_to_Java_Language_Lecture_1_
text: JVM means Java Virtual Machine.

title: 1_Introduction_to_Java_Language_Lecture_1_
text: So Java Virtual Machine of JRE and JDK, they are level-wise forms, level-wise stored.

title: 1_Introduction_to_Java_Language_Lecture_1_
text: And with the help of this, our entire Java code can be run.

title: 1_Introduction_to_Java_Language_Lecture_1_
text: Now if we understand these two stages, then what happens in the stage of compilation?

title: 1_Introduction_to_Java_Language_Lecture_1_
text: Whatever code we have written, we call it source code.

title: 1_Introduction_to_Java_Language_Lecture_1_
text: We save the source code from .java.

title: 1_Introduction_to_Java_Language_Lecture_1_
text: And all this code goes to a compiler.

text: This compiler is inside JDK.

title: 1_Introduction_to_Java_Language_Lecture_1_
text: And all the source code goes to this compiler.

title: 1_Introduction_to_Java_Language_Lecture_1_
text: And this compiler converts the source code into byte code.

title: 1_Introduction_to_Java_Language_Lecture_1_
text: Whose extension is .class.

title: 1_Introduction_to_Java_Language_Lecture_1_
text: And this byte code can run on any operating system.

title: 1_Introduction_to_Java_Language_Lecture_1_
text: As long as there is JRE Java Runtime Environment in that operating system.

title: 1_Introduction_to_Java_Language_Lecture_1_
text: So if you have written code in Linux, Windows, Mac OS,

title: 1_Introduction_to_Java_Language_Lecture_1_
text: you can convert your code into byte code and run it on any system.

title: 1_Introduction_to_Java_Language_Lecture_1_
text: You can't do this with C++.

title: 1_Introduction_to_Java_Language_Lecture_1_
text: That's why Java is called a portable language.

title: 1_Introduction_to_Java_Language_Lecture_1_
text: Because you can convert the apps made in it into byte code and run it on any system.

title: 1_Introduction_to_Java_Language_Lecture_1_
text: So we covered the first stage, which was the stage of compilation.

text: Now if we talk about our second stage, which is the stage of execution.

title: 1_Introduction_to_Java_Language_Lecture_1_
text: The byte code we had, now Java Virtual Machine takes this byte code.

text: Native code means the code that the machine understands.

text: That is 0 and 1.

title: 1_Introduction_to_Java_Language_Lecture_1_
text: So native code is the same code that the machine understands.

title: 1_Introduction_to_Java_Language_Lecture_1_
text: Now when this byte code is converted into native code,

text: then whether your machine is Windows or Mac,

text: now it will understand your Java code.

title: 1_Introduction_to_Java_Language_Lecture_1_
text: And that function was a function called void main.

title: 1_Introduction_to_Java_Language_Lecture_1_
text: The function's name was main and its return type was void.

title: 1_Introduction_to_Java_Language_Lecture_1_
text: Void means empty.

title: 1_Introduction_to_Java_Language_Lecture_1_
text: This function doesn't return anything.

title: 1_Introduction_to_Java_Language_Lecture_1_
text: It only printed Hello World for us.

title: 1_Introduction_to_Java_Language_Lecture_1_
text: So whatever code we have to write in Java,

title: 1_Introduction_to_Java_Language_Lecture_1_
text: we write it in functions.

title: 1_Introduction_to_Java_Language_Lecture_1_
text: And we write these functions in class.

title: 1_Introduction_to_Java_Language_Lecture_1_
text: So class is a big entity that can have a lot of functions.

title: 1_Introduction_to_Java_Language_Lecture_1_
text: How do we understand class?

title: 1_Introduction_to_Java_Language_Lecture_1_
text: For example, we have a big kitchen in our house

title: 1_Introduction_to_Java_Language_Lecture_1_
text: which has a lot of small boxes with some things stored inside.

title: 1_Introduction_to_Java_Language_Lecture_1_
text: For example, there is one box of sugar in the kitchen,

title: 1_Introduction_to_Java_Language_Lecture_1_
text: and one box of salt.

title: 1_Introduction_to_Java_Language_Lecture_1_
text: Similarly, there is a big class in Java that has small functions.

title: 1_Introduction_to_Java_Language_Lecture_1_
text: Some work is happening in one function,

title: 1_Introduction_to_Java_Language_Lecture_1_
text: and some work is happening in the other function.

title: 1_Introduction_to_Java_Language_Lecture_1_
text: And in Java classes, the main function of the name

title: 1_Introduction_to_Java_Language_Lecture_1_
text: is the first part of the code that is executed.

title: 1_Introduction_to_Java_Language_Lecture_1_
text: So the first thing written in the main function in Java

title: 1_Introduction_to_Java_Language_Lecture_1_
text: will be executed first.

title: 1_Introduction_to_Java_Language_Lecture_1_
text: Later, all the code things will be executed and coming to us.

title: 1_Introduction_to_Java_Language_Lecture_1_
text: So in today's class, we tried to understand a lot of things

title: 1_Introduction_to_Java_Language_Lecture_1_
text: like what is code, what is coding,

title: 1_Introduction_to_Java_Language_Lecture_1_
text: how the machine understands things,

title: 1_Introduction_to_Java_Language_Lecture_1_
text: and how we actually write our Java code.

title: 1_Introduction_to_Java_Language_Lecture_1_
text: I hope that before the next class,

title: 1_Introduction_to_Java_Language_Lecture_1_
text: you download your code editor,

title: 1_Introduction_to_Java_Language_Lecture_1_
text: Visual Studio Code or whatever editor you like,

title: 1_Introduction_to_Java_Language_Lecture_1_
text: along with Java Development Kit,

title: 1_Introduction_to_Java_Language_Lecture_1_
text: so that we can write and run the code along with the class in the next class.

title: 1_Introduction_to_Java_Language_Lecture_1_
text: We can see if we are getting any problem,

title: 1_Introduction_to_Java_Language_Lecture_1_
text: or are we able to learn all the things well?

title: 1_Introduction_to_Java_Language_Lecture_1_
text: We are able to do it.

title: 1_Introduction_to_Java_Language_Lecture_1_
text: Because it is more important to practice coding,

title: 1_Introduction_to_Java_Language_Lecture_1_
text: so the more we practice, the better we will understand the code.

title: 1_Introduction_to_Java_Language_Lecture_1_
text: That's all for today.

text: See you in the next video.
